name: Goodie Mob
notes: The darker, political wing of the school, and the only entry in this batch that is authored by **subtraction**. Organized Noize's stated method — "go in and take some stuff out" — is quoted in this paragraph as the instruction to keep simultaneous parts low, so almost every density number here is the lowest in the batch: `kick.densityPerBar` [2,3] at `syncopation` 0.28, `snare.ghost.prob` 0.22 on two positions rather than eight, plain 8th hats at `fillDensity` 0.34, two perc lanes at [1,2] and 8 dB down, and `melody.emptyBarBias` 0.2 so bars are allowed to be empty. The research's "sections defined by instrument removal rather than by fills" is authored twice over: `switchUpProb` falls to 0.2, and the `sectionRules` change the part list rather than the density — the verse plays without the lead, the outro is keys and voice for the spoken tag. The colour is the other half: "minor with modal/gothic colour" is `phrygian` and `harmonic_minor` in the scale weights and `halfStepDissonance` 0.14, and "minor 9th pads" is `extensions.ninth` 0.34 over an open voicing that reaches down to 40. The named families are i–VI–VII and i–iv, with the plagal iv–i as the church-derived cadence. CeeLo's sung line is documented as acting as a second lead, so `countermelody.fillGapsOnly` is false at `densityRatio` 0.55 — it sings *through* the lead rather than in its gaps. ⚠ **Confidence is medium and the inferred parameter is the tempo.** The research sources the subtractive philosophy and the chart facts but marks 70–90 [LOW-CONF] and gives both feels; 78 as the centre is mine, and the half-time reading is left to the inherited `dark church` mode rather than claimed here. ⚠ `bass808.register` drops to [19,34] with `slideProb` 0.04 because the research says the 808 is *reinforcement on the low root* — it stays the parent's `counter_riff` role so the played bass still sounds, and it is pushed below that bass rather than made to compete with it. `timbreHint` is `church_organ` for the organ and choir pads named first. This model's fill band is `smallEveryBars` 2 / `bigEveryBars` 4 with a 16th/32nd strong-weak roll, and inside that band it is the gappiest and flattest of the seven — `gapProb` 0.63, `descendProb` 0.14, `rampJitter` 15 — which is the same subtraction applied to the fill itself. ⚠ **`lockTo808` raised from 0.3 to 0.61.** The 808 takes each kick with this probability, and at 0.3 over this model's 8-kick floor a seed could produce no 808 at all — which `bass808.rs` refuses, because a declared 808 that sometimes vanishes is a part a producer cannot rely on. It is still well under a lock: a good share of kicks carry no sub. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 45 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 6. ⚠ `countermelody.registerOffset` moved from 5 to 12: inside a fifth the counter sits in the melody's own register and plays its pitches at the same moment, which `coherence.rs` calls a second lead rather than an answer.
